description: Header file defining WebSocket connection management classes, including WebSocket server, channel, and message handling with automation integration.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections, including server, channels, and message processing with optional automation forwarding.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for WebSocket connection parameters.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::JSONObjectFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating JSON elements used in WebSocket messages.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::WebSocketServer
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket server handling incoming connections and messages.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::WebSocketChannel
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client channels for communication.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::AutomationMessage
classes.description: JSON container for automation message details (conditional on ENABLE_APP_GATEWAY_AUTOMATION).

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::ConnectionUpdate
classes.description: JSON container for connection status updates (conditional on ENABLE_APP_GATEWAY_AUTOMATION).

methods.name: SetMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling incoming messages.

methods.name: SetAuthHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling authentication.

methods.name: SetDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling disconnections.

methods.name: SetAutomationId
methods.description: Sets the automation server ID for forwarding messages.

methods.name: SendMessageToConnection
methods.description: Sends a response message to a specific connection.

methods.name: DispatchNotificationToConnection
methods.description: Sends a notification to a specific connection.

methods.name: SendRequestToConnection
methods.description: Sends a request message to a specific connection.

methods.name: UpdateConnection
methods.description: Updates connection status to the automation server.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket channel using a NodeId.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a specific connection by ID.
